runtime_initial_dirty_files.behavior_scope: Frozen copy records effective configuration; the capture scripts pass case settings explicitly.
not imported or executed by capture

bundle.paths: relative to bundle root; execution records and operation SQLite paths describe the original execution
bundle.layout: frozen inputs stored once; capture retains changed inputs and four raw flow/level streams per scenario; rebased history copies, duplicate repeat files, repeat grids, unused flood map, ancillary outputs and decoding staging omitted

registry.preferred_series: per-station ANA preference as represented in capture/review-input.csv; unselected records retained
registry.rebased_note: The original capture and repeat rebased histories were byte-identical. Fresh working copies are made from frozen/history-original.sqlite and rebased during reproduction; the original path changes are recorded in capture/rebases.json.

correction.order: translation then rotation around original center

observation_review.sequence_rule: at least five consecutive hourly values strictly between 0 and 1 mm

initial_state.limitation: Saved CI files and HOT.HOT were not observed opened in prior file-open tracing; DATA.hot was opened read/write but post-execution bytes matched the frozen input. Saved state date differs from simulation; no initial-state compatibility claimed.
initial_state.trace_provenance: Historical diagnostic of aligned metadata using zero forcing before final capture; open calls indicate files accessed in that diagnostic only. rewind-trace.txt separately shows YTUDO rewind.
initial_state.companion_before_evidence: recover-level.py restores zero/DATA.before.hot in the private recovery Input before execution; its post-execution bytes matched the frozen input.
initial_state.after_each_note: Post-execution DATA.hot bytes matched the frozen original in all scenario and recovery runs; only one copy is retained.
